name: Audit Record Generation
supplemental_guidance: Audit records can be generated from many different system components. The event types specified in AU-2d are the event types for which audit logs are to be generated and are a subset of all event types for which the system can generate audit records.

enhancements.name: System-wide and Time-correlated Audit Trail
enhancements.statement: Compile audit records from [Assignment: organization-defined system components] into a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail that is time-correlated to within [Assignment: organization-defined level of tolerance for the relationship between time stamps of individual records in the audit trail].

enhancements.name: Standardized Formats
enhancements.statement: Produce a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail composed of audit records in a standardized format.

enhancements.name: Changes by Authorized Individuals
enhancements.statement: Provide and implement the capability for [Assignment: organization-defined individuals or roles] to change the logging to be performed on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] based on [Assignment: organization-defined selectable event criteria] within [Assignment: organization-defined time thresholds].

enhancements.name: Query Parameter Audits of Personally Identifiable Information
enhancements.statement: Provide and implement the capability for auditing the parameters of user query events for data sets containing personally identifiable information.
